issues.description: Duplicate db.sh entries: file added both as symlink and as a modification to TEMPLATE
issues.detail: The diff modifies egs2/TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh to add TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads AND creates egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/db.sh as a new file (not symlink-then-add). Looking closer, the second db.sh is a symlink to ../../TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh which is fine, but the new-file mode 120000 for db.sh in the recipe dir is correct. However, the recipe-level db.sh is the symlink while another db.sh entry is being added to TEMPLATE — verify only one db.sh file is added in egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh fails to exit when unzip is missing or args are wrong
issues.detail: Line 9-11: if unzip is missing the script only echoes a message but does not exit, so the script continues and later commands fail confusingly. Line 13-21: the usage block prints help but never exits non-zero, so an invalid invocation proceeds with $1 unset, which then crashes under set -u at realpath $1. Add 'exit 1' after both messages.

issues.description: README references a config path that does not exist
issues.detail: README.md says 'ASR config: ./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml' but the actual file is conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml (no train/ subdirectory). The visible link text is correct but the href is wrong, so the link will 404.

issues.description: Unquoted command substitutions with set -u will break on paths with spaces
issues.detail: extract_dir=$(realpath $1) and zip_dir=$(realpath ${2:-$extract_dir}) are unquoted. If the download path contains spaces, realpath receives multiple args and fails. Use realpath "$1" and "${2:-$extract_dir}".

issues.description: Hardcoded transcript sanitization may corrupt non-Mandarin text and is fragile
issues.detail: local/data.sh lines 39-42 strip Chinese punctuation via a chain of sed calls and also replace fullwidth 'A' with ASCII 'A'. This is brittle — any other fullwidth char remains, and the substitutions silently change transcripts. Consider using a single tr/python normalization with documented rules, and validate against the published transcript spec.

issues.description: data.sh sources db.sh after parse_options, so $TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH check may use stale env
issues.detail: parse_options.sh is called before db.sh is sourced (lines 13-16). More importantly, the script uses '. ./local/download_and_untar.sh' (sourced, not executed), so its 'exit' calls will terminate data.sh too. Either invoke it as a subprocess (bash ./local/...) or document the sourcing intent; current behavior means any non-zero exit in download_and_untar aborts data.sh midway.

review.summary: The recipe follows the standard ESPnet egs2 template and looks structurally complete, but several shell scripts have robustness issues. Most critical: download_and_untar.sh never exits on missing unzip or bad args, leading to confusing downstream failures. The README links to a nonexistent config path (conf/train/...), and data.sh sources download_and_untar.sh which mixes control flow. Transcript normalization via chained seds is fragile. None of these affect users who follow the happy path with all three TAL_ASR zips already downloaded, but they will bite operators trying to debug.
